title: King Alfons of the Ṭāʾifa of Aragon dies at Benabarre. His son Rodrigo, a boy of eleven, succeeds him
source: save of 3 September 1398 (people.json records of Alfons and Rodrigo)

title: Fear of al-Andalus binds its neighbours: Castile (3 May), Portugal (6 May) and Andorra (17 August) take up a coalition casus belli against the empire. The court calls it the League, and the war it brings will carry its name
